Leny Yoro's red card for Manchester United against Liverpool overturned following successful appeal
Leny Yoro's red card against Liverpool has been overturned following a successful appeal; Yoro was sent off inside the first eight minutes for denying a clear goalscoring opportunity; the club informed the FA of their plans to appeal decision on Monday; Yoro available to face Brentford
Tuesday 24 November 2026 15:43, UK
Leny Yoro's red card against Liverpool has been overturned following a successful appeal from Manchester United.
Mauricio Pochettino's side lost 4-0 at Anfield in the Argentine's first game in charge, and his plans went up in smoke as Yoro was dismissed inside the first eight minutes for bundling over Alexander Isak as the striker ran through on goal.
Yoro was set to serve a one-match suspension but it has now been removed after United lodged an appeal on Monday, claiming it was a wrongful dismissal.

The 21-year-old will now be available to face Brentford on Saturday at Old Trafford.
There was some debate as to whether the foul was a clear denial of the goalscoring opportunity, as it was unclear whether Isak was in control of the ball as he made his way towards the penalty area.
Under the laws of the game, one of the considerations regarding a red card for Denying an Obvious Goalscoring Opportunity (DOGSO) is the likelihood of the attacking player "keeping or gaining control of the ball".
United boss Pochettino felt that not only did Isak lose control of the ball with his touch, but that United should have been given a penalty for Jeremy Jacquet's challenge on Bryan Mbeumo at the opposite end just moments before.
However, former Premier League referee Dermot Gallagher backed the on-field decision in both instances.
"If you look at it from the referee's angle, is it a foul? That's the first step. Yes. Is he in possession of the ball? From that angle, yes," Gallagher said on Sky Sports News.
"I think most people would have expected a red card. It would have been a surprise during the game if a red card hadn't been given.
"I don't know if he would have got to the ball before Lammens. You watch it play out. Do you think it's a red card? Gary Neville's immediate reaction was red card."
On Mbeumo's penalty appeal: "When players are side by side, you can do that. They are side by side. Jacquet was even in front of him."
Pochettino: 'The ball was for the goalkeeper'
United boss Pochettino said it was not a denial of a goalscoring opportunity as goalkeeper Senne Lammens was the favourite to claim it and Yoro did not intentionally make contact with Isak.
"The ball was for the goalkeeper. In that situation, if you review the VAR you can see for sure, [Yoro] never had the intention to connect with Isak," Pochettino said after the game.
"When the control was long with the striker, the ball was going to the goalkeeper, he runs and goes down. In Leny's case, it wasn't intentional.
"If you look before, on the sixth minute. Jacquet on Mbeumo. Similar? No. If you compare the actions, that was a penalty."
'No chance' - Mainoo fumes at penalty decision
United midfielder Kobbie Mainoo disagreed with the on-field decision, claiming Yoro and Isak were both running at full speed and contact could not have been avoided.
"The game's been taken out of our hands by a red card that I don't think can be a red card," he said.
"No chance. The ball's already with the goalkeeper. They're both running full speed. What can we do? It is what it is.
"It's 10 vs 11, you come to a place like Anfield, it's a tough game anyway. Then you lose a man, it makes it hard. I can't fault the boys for their fight in the game. We take the pain and move on.
"I wouldn't say it all goes out the window. You can still take the things you did in training into the game, but it makes it 10 times harder with one less man in a situation like that."

הכרטיס האדום שספג בלם מנצ'סטר יונייטד, לני יורו, במשחק נגד ליברפול בוטל בעקבות ערעור שהגיש המועדון. יורו הורחק תוך שמונה דקות בלבד מתחילת ההתמודדות באנפילד לאחר שנפגק בחלוץ היריבה אלכסנדר איסק בטענה למניעת מצב ודאי הבקעה, במשחקו הראשון של המאמן מאוריציו פוצ'טינו על הקווים.

בעקבות קבלת הערעור על ידי ההתאחדות לכדורגל בטענה להרחקה שגויה, הוסר העונש שעמד על השעיה למשחק אחד. כתוצאה מכך, השחקן בן ה-21 יהיה זמין לשירות הקבוצה במשחק הקרוב מול ברנטפורד באצטדיון אולד טראפורד.

ההחלטה המקורית של השופט עוררה דיונים נרחבים בתקשורת לגבי השליטה של החלוץ בכדור בטרם העבירה, כאשר הצוות המקצועי ושחקני מנצ'סטר יונייטד הביעו תרעומת פומבית על ההכרעה. מנגד, שופטי עבר ובכירים בתחום גיבו את ההחלטה המקורית של צוות השיפוט במגרש.
